🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin hovers near $77K as US midterm voting, ETF outflows and Binance-hack fallout keep traders defensive. Early recovery signals are emerging, but sentiment remains firmly in fear territory. 📉 Bitcoin Steadies Near $76,900 as ETF Outflows and Midterms Weigh Bitcoin dipped to about $76,300 during the European morning before stabilizing near $76,900. US spot bitcoin ETFs shed $399 million on Monday — a second straight day of outflows — with BlackRock's IBIT losing $405 million, its biggest daily exit since June. Options traders are bracing for volatility around today's US midterm vote, pushing near-dated implied volatility to roughly 51%. Read full story 🏦 Binance Net Outflows Hit $5.3B as Hourly Deposits Turn Positive Users pulled $10.97 billion from Binance in the 46 hours after its record $6.4 billion hack, leaving net outflows of $5.28 billion, according to on-chain data shared by CEO Richard Teng. Withdrawal pressure peaked on Nov. 1, but by early Nov. 3 hourly deposits exceeded withdrawals by about $10 million — a shift Teng cites as a sign of stabilization. More details 🇰🇵 North Korea Denies Role in $6.4B Binance Hack Kim Yo Jong, sister of leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the FBI's attribution of the theft to the TraderTraitor group as a political provocation in a statement carried by state agency KCNA. Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic countered that on-chain evidence backs the FBI and said $2.85 billion of the stolen funds has already been frozen or seized. Read more ⚖️ SEC Clarifies When DAO Governance Signals Central Control The SEC's Division of Corporation Finance added three new answers to its crypto-asset FAQ, stating that unrelated token holders don't become a controlling group simply by voting — while coordinated blocs or concentrated delegated power may. The guidance also separates a functioning network from a truly decentralized one; it is a staff view with no legal force. See details 💰 Tether Says It Holds ~150,000 BTC Worth $11.5B Speaking at the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano, CEO Paolo Ardoino said Tether holds roughly 150,000 bitcoin — about 50,000 more than its BDO-attested Q3 reserve report implies. He didn't say where the extra coins sit or when they were acquired; holdings outside USDT reserves, such as Tether's investments, wouldn't appear in that report. Read full story 🇧🇷 Mercado Bitcoin Will Cover Al

**Claim your $100**

Sign up here to get LLM access in one minute:

1. **Sign up** at [https://app.blockworks.com/claim](https://app.blockworks.com/claim)** ** 

2. **Connect your AI.** Add the Blockworks MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client and sign in with your Blockworks account. Building something? Copy your API key from the account page instead.

3. **Ask.** Try: "What's driving Solana revenue over the last 90 days? Compare it to Robinhood and chart both."

Setup guides for each client are at [docs.blockworks.com](https://docs.blockworks.com).
